full_text: Medical Board of California Decision and Order, Stipulated Settlement and Disciplinary Order in the Matter of the Accusation Against Hozair Mohammed Syed, M.D., Certificate No. A 111058, Case No. 800-2019-062318. Effective May 19, 2023, Dr. Syed's certificate is revoked, stayed, and placed on probation for five (5) years. Disciplinary terms include a mandatory Patient Disclosure under SB 1448, educational course, medical record keeping course, professionalism program (ethics course), practice monitor, psychiatric evaluation, psychotherapy, and a prohibition on supervising physician assistants or advanced practice nurses. Accusation filed by Rob Bonta, Attorney General of California, alleging gross negligence, repeated negligent acts, incompetence, and failure to maintain adequate medical records.
